title: Accessing trifluoromethylated SuFEx-able pyrazole via distortion-accelerated 1,3-dipolar cycloadditions
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41924-41933
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07095C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bipin Khanal, Mark Aldren M. Feliciano, Brian Gold
Trifluoromethyl-substituted 1H-pyrazoles are abundant in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and bioactive compounds. We report facile access to SuFEx-able derivatives, enabling modular diversification of this valuable heterocyclic scaffold.
